humanDecision: 2026-10-31: a first-time operator must be able to install the MCP server with one simple prompt; quick start uses Claude Code on Linux/WSL with masked --token entry (both choices made by the user).
method: verify-readme-quickstart.py extracts the README quick-start/owner blocks, substitutes placeholders and runs each command in a fresh bash without DOTNET_ROOT/MCPCLI_HOME/EVENTSTORE_*/NUGET_* under a scratch HOME; the token is piped into the README's masked read and never printed. Scratch roots (holding a profile token) were deleted afterwards.
result: All eight steps exit 0: owner handoff, start folder, install 1.2.0, masked token profile add, tenant/actor/current, claude mcp add + get (Connected), read-only tenant query (system / selected tenant Active), registration removal.

defectFound.what: README's Claude Code registration `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope local --env MCPCLI_HOME=... hexalith -- ...` fails on Claude Code 2.1.316 with `Invalid environment variable format: hexalith` because --env is variadic and consumes the server name.
defectFound.fix: Server name immediately after `add`; README reference command corrected and troubleshooting row added.
defectFound.whyUnnoticed: The earlier Claude Code registration (sessions/claude-code/registration-20261031) was written to the config directly, not via the README command.

domainCalls: Two read-only tenants.get-tenant queries across the two runs; no command submitted.
notVerified: Running `claude mcp add` from inside the operator's own interactive Claude Code session, and the interactive /exit, /mcp and task prompt; these are exercised by the timed session.
